Germantown, MD · Made by Our Dessert Chef

La Dulcería

Churros fried to order. Flan with real caramel. Tres leches soaked properly. Every dessert made here, by a chef whose whole job is the sweet end of the menu.

Order Dessert Reserve

Don’t Skip This Part

Most restaurants order dessert in frozen. We hired a pastry chef instead. Cajeta cooked down for hours, caramel that's actually caramelized, sponge that drinks up all three milks and stays standing.

Order it with coffee, with a café de olla, or with an añejo. Or take a box home. Ask about custom cakes for any occasion.
